provider_exposure: both providers receive every query; no provider fallback
query_generation: pre-authored informational topics; compact Treatment and non-compact Control paraphrase; NFC, lowercase, trimmed, no labels/features/providers/temporal or commercial intent
pair_rule: same topic, one Treatment and one Control query, generated before randomization
exclusion_sets: duplicate across providers within current pair
universe_freeze_gate: do not generate or freeze this universe until attainability preflight passes for both providers and both arms
